critical_code_review_comments: RealtimeContext.tsx: EventSource has no onerror handler and no reconnect/backoff — if the connection drops (proxy timeout, network flap) the client silently stops receiving updates until a re-render or login change. Consider onerror + exponential-backoff reconnect. Impact today is low because polling still runs at 30s.

stream.py: on invalid token the endpoint currently returns 401 as a JSON response (good). EventSource in the browser will fire 'error' without a body — combined with the missing onerror above, this is silent. Non-blocking.
